description: This file implements classes and methods for managing QPACK header tables in QUIC, including encoder and decoder header table operations such as insertion, lookup, and eviction policies.

classes.name: QpackEncoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the encoder's dynamic and static header tables, supporting insertion, header field lookup, and eviction logic.

classes.name: QpackDecoderHeaderTable
classes.description: Manages the decoder's static and dynamic header tables, supports insertion, lookup, and observer notification.

methods.name: InsertEntry
methods.description: Inserts a header entry into the encoder or decoder header table, updating internal indices and structures.

methods.name: FindHeaderField
methods.description: Finds a header field in the encoder's header table, returning match type and index.

methods.name: MaxInsertSizeWithoutEvictingGivenEntry
methods.description: Calculates the maximum size of new entries that can be inserted without evicting a specified entry.

methods.name: draining_index
methods.description: Calculates the index up to which entries can be drained based on a draining fraction.

methods.name: RemoveEntryFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the oldest entry from the encoder's dynamic table.

methods.name: LookupEntry
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the decoder's static or dynamic table by index.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer to be notified when the header table reaches a certain insert count.
